# REST API support

<!-- Generated by tools/restprobe. Do not edit; run `just docs` to regenerate. -->

This page lists every method of the [BigQuery v2 REST API](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest),
from the discovery document in `third_party/bigquery/discovery.json`, and whether the emulator
serves it. Behavior these tables cannot show is described in [compatibility.md](compatibility.md).

`tools/restprobe` sends each request in `tools/api_methods.txt` to an emulator holding dataset
`test.d` with table `t (id INT64)` and a finished query job `j`, and probes a method without
requests there with one built from its path. A probe checks only that a request succeeds, not
that the response matches BigQuery's. The notes of a Partial method list the features the
emulator rejected.

- **Supported**: every request succeeds.
- **Partial**: some requests succeed, and the emulator rejects the others as unsupported.
- **Unsupported**: the emulator does not serve the method, or rejects every request as
  unsupported.
- **Broken**: a request fails with an internal error, which is a bug.
- **Untested**: the probe's request failed for another reason.

| Resource | Supported | Partial | Unsupported |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [datasets](#datasets) | 5 | 1 | 1 |
| [jobs](#jobs) | 5 | 2 | 0 |
| [models](#models) | 0 | 0 | 4 |
| [projects](#projects) | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| [routines](#routines) | 3 | 2 | 3 |
| [rowAccessPolicies](#rowaccesspolicies) | 0 | 0 | 8 |
| [tabledata](#tabledata) | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| [tables](#tables) | 3 | 3 | 3 |

## datasets

| Method | HTTP request | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`datasets.delete`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets/delete) | `DELETE projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}` | Supported |  |
| [`datasets.get`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets/get) | `GET projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}` | Supported | Returns the reference, description, friendly name, labels, default table expiration and default rounding mode, and location `US`. |
| [`datasets.insert`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets/insert) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/datasets` | Partial | See [Datasets](compatibility.md#datasets). Unsupported: dataset field access; dataset location EU. |
| [`datasets.list`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets/list) | `GET projects/{projectsId}/datasets` | Supported | Filters by label value or key presence (`labels.key` or `labels.key:*`), combining up to ten unique keys with AND before pagination. |
| [`datasets.patch`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets/patch) | `PATCH projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}` | Supported | Changes `description`, `friendlyName`, `labels`, `defaultTableExpirationMs`, which `0` clears, and `defaultRoundingMode`. Ignores the etag. |
| [`datasets.undelete`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets/undelete) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}:undelete` | Unsupported |  |
| [`datasets.update`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/datasets/update) | `PUT projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}` | Supported | Behaves like `datasets.patch`, except that it replaces the description, friendly name, labels and default table expiration. |

## jobs

| Method | HTTP request | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`jobs.cancel`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/cancel) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/jobs/{jobsId}/cancel` | Supported | See [Jobs](compatibility.md#jobs). |
| [`jobs.delete`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/delete) | `DELETE projects/{projectsId}/jobs/{jobsId}/delete` | Supported |  |
| [`jobs.get`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/get) | `GET projects/{projectsId}/jobs/{jobsId}` | Supported |  |
| [`jobs.getQueryResults`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/getQueryResults) | `GET projects/{projectsId}/queries/{queriesId}` | Supported | Ignores `timeoutMs`, `location` and `formatOptions.timestampOutputFormat`. |
| [`jobs.insert`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/insert) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/jobs` | Partial | See [Jobs](compatibility.md#jobs) and [Loads, extracts and copies](compatibility.md#loads-extracts-and-copies). Unsupported: Avro extracts; appending rows of another schema to ROUND_HALF_EVEN columns; clustering for a destination table; copy operationType CLONE; extracting models; load jobs into ROUND_HALF_EVEN columns; multiple destination URIs. |
| [`jobs.list`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/list) | `GET projects/{projectsId}/jobs` | Supported | Ignores `allUsers`. See [Jobs](compatibility.md#jobs). |
| [`jobs.query`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/jobs/query) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/queries` | Partial | Ignores `timeoutMs`, `location`, `labels` and `useQueryCache`. Unsupported: legacy SQL. |

| [`projects.getServiceAccount`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects/getServiceAccount) | `GET projects/{projectsId}/serviceAccount` | Supported | Names the account after the configured project number; see [Projects](../README.md#projects). |

## routines

| Method | HTTP request | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`routines.delete`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines/delete) | `DELETE projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/routines/{routinesId}` | Supported |  |
| [`routines.get`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines/get) | `GET projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/routines/{routinesId}` | Supported | Describes the persistent SQL UDFs that `CREATE FUNCTION` creates: their arguments, return type, body and description. |
| [`routines.getIamPolicy`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines/getIamPolicy) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/routines/{routinesId}:getIamPolicy` | Unsupported |  |
| [`routines.insert`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines/insert) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/routines` | Partial | Supports SQL scalar UDFs, whose references to other routines need a project ID. See [User-defined functions](compatibility.md#user-defined-functions). Unsupported: routines other than SQL scalar functions. |
| [`routines.list`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines/list) | `GET projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/routines` | Supported | Supports `routineType:{RoutineType}` filters and `readMask` field projection; always returns the routine reference. |
| [`routines.setIamPolicy`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines/setIamPolicy) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/routines/{routinesId}:setIamPolicy` | Unsupported |  |
| [`routines.testIamPermissions`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines/testIamPermissions) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/routines/{routinesId}:testIamPermissions` | Unsupported |  |
| [`routines.update`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/routines/update) | `PUT projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/routines/{routinesId}` | Partial | Preserves the creation time. See [User-defined functions](compatibility.md#user-defined-functions). Unsupported: non-SQL routines. |

## tabledata

| Method | HTTP request | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`tabledata.insertAll`](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest/v2/tabledata/insertAll) | `POST projects/{projectsId}/datasets/{datasetsId}/tables/{tablesId}/insertAll` | Partial | Ignores `insertId`, so retried rows are not deduplicated.
